checks.describe: the real v1.0 checkpoint test suite still passes (regression check ahead of the scratch demos)
checks.run: bash -c "cd labs/checkpoints/v1.0 && uv run pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -1"

checks.describe: pytest collects only the test_-prefixed function in a scratch file, never the helper
checks.run:
bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/m12dd && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/m12dd/test_demo.py
def test_collected():
    assert True

def helper_not_collected():
    assert True
PYEOF
cd labs/checkpoints/v1.0 && uv run pytest /tmp/m12dd/test_demo.py --collect-only -q"

checks.describe: a yield fixture's teardown half runs even when the test using it fails
checks.run:
bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/m12dd && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/m12dd/test_fixture_demo.py
import pytest

@pytest.fixture
def traced():
    print('SETUP')
    yield 1
    print('TEARDOWN')

def test_fails(traced):
    print('BODY')
    assert False
PYEOF
cd labs/checkpoints/v1.0 && uv run pytest /tmp/m12dd/test_fixture_demo.py -s -q"

checks.describe: pytest's assertion rewriting names the exact index where two lists differ
checks.run:
bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/m12dd && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/m12dd/test_assert_demo.py
def test_fails():
    assert [1, 2, 3] == [1, 2, 4]
PYEOF
cd labs/checkpoints/v1.0 && uv run pytest /tmp/m12dd/test_assert_demo.py -q"

checks.describe: coverage.py reports 100% for a non-branching function exercised by an assertion-free test
checks.run:
bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/m12dd && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/m12dd/is_healthy.py
def is_healthy(status_code):
    return status_code < 500
PYEOF
cat <<'PYEOF2' > /tmp/m12dd/test_is_healthy.py
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/m12dd')
from is_healthy import is_healthy

def test_is_healthy_runs_without_crashing():
    is_healthy(200)
PYEOF2
cd labs/checkpoints/v1.0 && uv run --with coverage coverage run -m pytest /tmp/m12dd/test_is_healthy.py -q && uv run --with coverage coverage report -m --include='*is_healthy.py'"

checks.describe: plain line coverage drops below 100% and names the untested else branch's line
checks.run:
bash -c "mkdir -p /tmp/m12dd && cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/m12dd/branchy.py
def classify_latency(latency_ms):
    if latency_ms < 200:
        return 'fast'
    else:
        return 'slow'
PYEOF
cat <<'PYEOF2' > /tmp/m12dd/test_branchy.py
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/m12dd')
from branchy import classify_latency

def test_classify_latency_labels_a_fast_response():
    assert classify_latency(50) == 'fast'
PYEOF2
cd labs/checkpoints/v1.0 && uv run --with coverage coverage run -m pytest /tmp/m12dd/test_branchy.py -q && uv run --with coverage coverage report -m --include='*branchy.py'"
